# Support

## Docker image, Compose and build problems

Start with the [installation and configuration guide](../docker.md). For problems
with either `slechev/openwebrxplus` or `slechev/openwebrxplus-softmbe`, the supplied
Compose setup, image packaging or this builder, open an issue in
[this repository](https://github.com/0xAF/openwebrxplus-docker-builder/issues).

Include the image tag, OpenWebRX+ version, host architecture, relevant SDR models,
steps to reproduce and relevant configuration and logs. Remove passwords and
tokens before posting. The bug report form provides fields for these details.

## General OpenWebRX+ usage and upstream behavior

For receiver configuration, supported modes and general usage, see the
[OpenWebRX+ Info Page](https://fms.komkon.org/OWRX/) or ask in the
[OpenWebRX+ community chat](https://t.me/openwebrx_chat).

For a problem reproduced in OpenWebRX+ itself outside these images, report it to
the [upstream OpenWebRX+ project](https://github.com/luarvique/openwebrx/issues).
If you are unsure whether the image or application is responsible, report it here
with the details above so it can be investigated.

## Plugins

For plugins from the OpenWebRX+ plugins collection, use its
[documentation](https://github.com/0xAF/openwebrxplus-plugins) and
[issue tracker](https://github.com/0xAF/openwebrxplus-plugins/issues).
For other plugins, contact their maintainers.

## Contributing fixes

See [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) for repository layout, local checks and PR guidance.
